tldr: Google Sheets does not have a native Mac app, but you can create a web shortcut in Chrome.
Use Cmd + / to see all keyboard shortcuts and speed up your data entry.

blocks.text: Setting up your Mac for Google Sheets

Since there is no official desktop app, you should run Sheets in its own window. Open Chrome, go to your sheet, and select the three-dot menu. Choose Save and share, then Create shortcut. Check the Open as window box. Now you can pin this to your Dock. It acts like a real app. You can switch to it with Cmd + Tab just like any other program.

Analysts deal with massive exports from platforms like Instagram or TikTok. These files are often messy. Use Data > Split text to columns to fix CSV imports. If your data has duplicates, use Data > Data cleanup > Remove duplicates. This saves you from manual errors.

items: Cmd + / : Open the full list of shortcuts.
Option + Cmd + Down Arrow : Select to the bottom of the data range.
Cmd + Shift + L : Turn filters on or off.
Fn + F2 : Edit the active cell.

blocks.text: Enable compatible spreadsheet shortcuts if you are used to Excel. You will find this toggle at the bottom of the keyboard shortcut menu. It makes your muscle memory work across both platforms.

Lazur lives in your Mac notch. Hold Option + Command to ask questions about your screen. If you are stuck on a formula, ask Lazur to explain it. If you need to find a specific setting in the menu, ask where it is. Lazur will draw a circle around the menu item for you.
Use the fn key to dictate your report summaries directly into your cells or notes. It is much faster than typing long explanations for your clients.
blocks.title: Dictate your insights

blocks.text: Google Sheets supports up to 20 million cells. If your sheet gets sluggish, check your formulas. Avoid volatile functions like INDIRECT or OFFSET if you do not need them. They recalculate every time you change a cell. This slows down your entire workbook.

items: Keeping too many tabs open in one browser window.
Over-using conditional formatting on entire columns.
Not using named ranges for complex formulas.
Sharing files with edit access when view-only is enough.

blocks.text: Always check your sharing settings. Go to File > Share to ensure your client only sees the data they need. If you have sensitive internal notes, keep them in a separate hidden tab. Right-click the tab name and select Hide sheet to keep it out of view.

faq.question: Is there a native Google Sheets app for Mac?
faq.answer: No, Google Sheets is a web-based app. You can create a web app shortcut in Chrome to make it feel like a native desktop application.

faq.question: How many cells can I have in a Google Sheet?
faq.answer: You can have up to 20 million cells in a single spreadsheet file.

faq.question: Does Lazur click buttons for me in Google Sheets?
faq.answer: No, Lazur does not click buttons or edit files. It guides you, explains how to do things, and helps you work faster by pointing at the screen.
